Marine works - Pipeline Jetty Contruction - Prince Rupert Harbour
Construction of a pipeline jetty from the shore will take place on the west side of Ridley Island in the vicinity of 54 12.971N 130 20.398W.
Operations active 24 hours per day. 
On site vessels monitoring VHF Ch. 16
Minimum wake
